P01.rationale: A large, full-bleed portrait of the founder dominates the upper half of the page, serving as the clear human anchor.

P05.rationale: No case study client portraits are present; the page contains no named client images at any size.

P07.rationale: There is no press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial block anywhere on the page.

P10.rationale: No oversized ghost numerals or large decorative quote glyphs are used as typographic ornaments.

P11.rationale: Two bold stat callouts (100+ projects, 30-50% cost reduction) are present but there are no charts, before/after visuals, or cost-math diagrams.

P12.rationale: The upper half is well-filled with the portrait and stat card, and the lower half has a large headline and bullet list, but there is a noticeable empty band between the photo and the text section that reduces overall density.

P13.rationale: The full-bleed dark photographic background provides atmospheric texture in the upper zone, though the lower section transitions to a flat dark field with no additional texture.

P14.rationale: The portrait photo has a dark, moody treatment that keeps the overlaid stat card and tag pills readable, though the scrim is implicit rather than an explicit gradient overlay.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a specific, professionally shot individual rather than an obvious stock photo, lending reasonable authenticity.

N08.rationale: A large empty band exists between the bottom edge of the portrait photo and the start of the headline/text section, creating noticeable dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: The stat card overlay on the photo is contained within a semi-transparent box, so text readability is maintained, though the tag pills at the top sit directly on the photo with minimal treatment.
